notes.title: Officially announcing our sweetest creation — High Times! 🍩
notes.content:
Hey gang,

We're super excited to publicly unveil our latest and sweetest creation: High Times.

In a world where you can get high with no consequences, the hardest drug to get over are your exes. In this (anti) dating sim about drugs and donuts, you'll manage a café, serve special donuts that get customers high, and live out the ultimate fantasy — getting closure with your exes!

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/db16936e5220834aa457fb733c1ae525916268c9.png

Welcome to The Hotbox!

It's the year 2069 (nice!), and miracles have been made in the name of science. The greatest of them all? Drugs are now totally safe to consume!

Set in the fictional world of San Mazo — which is totally not a rip off of LA — you're a Mood Confectioner (a fancy term for someone who bakes drugs into sweets) who must turn your boss' café, The Hotbox, into the hottest place in town or get fired. That isn’t the end of your problems, though — the exes whom you've ghosted are back in town and they all have a bone to pick with you.

Good luck, heartbreaker!

Game Genre: Simulation, Casual
Story Genre: Comedy, Slice of Life, Drama, Romance
Length: 8-10 hours, depending on reading speed (single playthrough)
Platforms: PC (Steam); Mobile (iOS/Android); Consoles (Nintendo Switch)
Languages: English, Simplified & Traditional Chinese (please stay tuned for more languages!)
Intended Release: 2024

SCREENSHOTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/6f3dc36f674855d433181a30bd4ef4b0f49dd775.jpg

FEATURES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/a4812e99b67f344a02a85a1ebfe55feabb47b630.gif
🍩 Customizable Main Character
Choose the face that broke many hearts for a more personal experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/b5370a3d2eec538661e59507f3ba7bd036b95524.gif
🍩 Donut Baking Sim
Manage your own Mood Café and serve special donuts that get the high times rolling! Know your clients, find out their tastes, and make those donuts that they’ve been craving for!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/0df8f996dfef1480a1dcb1106270e6516280b352.gif
🍩 Five Exes To Get Over
Surprise! Your exes are back to complicate things. They’ve got their own baggage, but you’re a Mood Confectioner, not a bellboy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/e57346d048ea21cfe3240e223e8f807e3354b6dc.gif
🍩 A Quirky Cast of Characters
From a girl in a chicken suit to a walking Jojo reference, San Mazo is full of zany characters. Meet them all, serve their favorite donuts, and find out what makes them tick.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/4e0565e148a93d6b42aace5bbe58e0302609978d.gif
🍩 English Voice Acting
A cast of professional English voice actors will be bringing the characters to life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/316a95d45f07b4658283a50590304d48c3937909.gif
🍩 Dynamic Comic Book-Styled Visuals
Watch your story come to life with animated comic book-styled panels and vibrant CGs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/236ea9f0ff9583e669daaca9676d0e2e1357bcfc.gif
🍩 Multiple Endings
Will you get lost in a temporary high, leave things a hot mess, or find closure? Be sure to listen to your customers! You’re not just serving donuts; you’re serving advice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/4260ff1f537802c45c4972f91b28e7c6af184fab.gif
🍩 Original Soundtrack
A blend of originally composed soundtracks that’ll make service time a time you can vibe to!

Please try out the demo of our next game!

Before we go, we'd like to promote our upcoming game, a horror visual novel called "Saint Maker".

The story of Saint Maker is inspired by the shows "Haunting of Hill House" and "Midnight Mass". You play as Holly Beltran, a young girl who experiences strange hauntings while visiting an old convent. The game will be dealing with both psychological and religious horror, and features eerie statues of saints coming to life — their faces cracked and twisted.

If this is something up your alley, we have a short demo available over at our Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1785300

We hope you give it a try and if you like it, please add the game to your wishlist! Thank you! 💛

notes.title: Our next game: Saint Maker!
notes.content:
Dear gang,

We'd like to officially announce our upcoming game, "Saint Maker", a religious psychological horror visual novel.

ABOUT THE GAME

While attending a religious recollection, Holly Beltran experiences strange hauntings throughout the convent. At night, broken faced statues and whispered prayers haunt Holly’s dreams — before the recollection is over, Holly may have to face more than her own demons to come out alive.

 Length: 4-8 hours, depending on reading speed
 Platforms: PC (Steam/Itch.io); Mobile (iOS/Android); Nintendo Switch
 Intended Release: 2022

[previewyoutube=pcLijhOfBbI;full][/previewyoutube]
FEATURES

✟ Religious/Psychological Horror: Experience a horror story rich with eerie religious iconography and psychological scares.

✟ Fully Voiced: A full cast of professional English voice actors will be bringing the characters to life.

✟ Interactive Dialogue Choices: As the horror unfolds, your choices will help Holly discover more about herself during this ordeal.

✟ Bone-chilling Visuals: Witness the haunting setting of the Convent of the Sisters of Saint Idelora, with detailed backgrounds, CGs, and animated illustrations adding to an immersive and terrifying experience.

✟ Original Soundtrack: Originally composed soundtracks which add both horror and heart to the story.

PLEASE ADD SAINT MAKER TO YOUR STEAM WISHLIST:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1785300

Saint Maker's development is funded through our Patreon. If you'd like to support us, please consider subscribing!

notes.title: Linux Now Available + Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Dear gang,

We bring you news today!

Linux Build is now available!

We're happy to announce that the game is now available on Linux systems. Thank you for waiting! ːirenesmileː

Patch Notes for v1.0.4.

We also updated our Windows version today to v1.0.4. Here's our patch notes:


 Fixed a bug wherein volume sliders are always set to 0 in the Options window.
 Fixed a bug wherein the Options window doesn't close when changes are applied.
 Fixed a bug wherein the game's fps locks to 30 whenever the Texture Quality is set to 540p.
 Fixed a bug wherein the game still runs in the background even though its setting is turned off.
 Fixed a bug Long chapter titles texts in the Save/Load Game window bleeds out from its text box.
 Fixed a bug wherein some texts in the Extras menu are still in English even though the language setting has been changed to another language.
 Fixed a bug wherein unlocking multiple achievements at the same time shows the same achievement name.
 Fixed a grammatical bug in the German localization, from "XX vor Monaten" to "Vor XX Monaten..."
 Updated the Perfect Gold Artbook DLC and fixed numerous text issues.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554350/Perfect_Gold__Digital_Artbook/
Upcoming:
 Fixes for Simplified Chinese language
 Mobile Port


Thank you so much for your continued patience! We're constantly improving the game for better experience! Please look forward to our next patch! ːmariongrinː

notes.title: Perfect Gold is out!!
notes.content:
Dear gang,

After more than a year of development, we're proud to announce that Perfect Gold is finally released!!

[previewyoutube=zWKeK0WiRpU;full][/previewyoutube]
Perfect Gold: The Alchemy of Happiness is a short, coming-of-age yuri visual novel about two former friends who escape detention in order to celebrate the Sunflower Festival. Set in the magical city of Castlecoast, readers get to know Audrey Clary, an alchemy student and heiress who secretly dreams of a different life, and Marion LaRue, a rebellious elemental magic student in search of someone she once loved.

With around 2 hours of gameplay, you can get the game for $7.99 USD, with a 10% discount during our launch week. 

If yuri is your cup of tea, be sure to get a copy of the game while it’s on discount! Don’t forget to share it to your friends and leave us a review! ːsimonewinkː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/578540

Our other games are also on sale! 

To celebrate Perfect Gold's release, we've also put our other games on sale!

If you're into horror and pain, please check out The Letter. If your laifu is all about waifu, please check out Love Esquire.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/849740
https://store.steampowered.com/app/460430

Sale ends at the end of Perfect Gold's launch week (April 26).

Thank you so much! We hope to see you all again in our next games! ːirenesmileː

notes.title: Steam Festival 2021: Beta Demo
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37910603/b31a48a740e0ab5467c8ed8f9f0921f0b3894fdf.png

Dear gang,

In light of the Steam Festival 2021, we've upgraded Perfect Gold's alpha demo into a beta demo. We've added the following key features to enhance your gameplay experience:

 Full English Voice Acting
 Gallery
 Localization (Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian and German)

What to expect on release

Please expect more features to be implemented in the game, such as mouth animation and Steam achievements. In addition, the beta demo's overall quality still has some rough edges; we'll iron those out, so you can expect the game's final version to have a higher level of polish.

Our launch is near, so please don't forget to wishlist the game to get notified when it releases! We'll have a 10% discount on launch week. ːamyhappyː 💛

Discord Q&A

Just like before, we invite all of you to join our live Q&A session over at our Discord server. We'll be online this Monday, February 8th, from 6:00pm-7:00pm (+8 GMT).

See you soon! (◍•ᴗ•◍)❤
